# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery platform for finding and saving creative ideas, offering APIs for developers and advertisers to integrate with its product catalog and conversion tracking systems.

Pinterest enables users to discover and organize visual content across categories like recipes, home decor, fashion, and travel. The platform provides developer tools including the Pinterest API, Conversions API, and Shopping API for building integrations and managing advertising campaigns.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Pinterest Tag
- Pinterest API for Shopping
- Content Discovery
- Visual Ideas & Inspiration
- Product Catalogs
- Ads Management
- Board Collections
- Trending Content
- Developer Tools
- Conversions Tracking
- Social Media Profile
- Browse Categories
- Seasonal Picks

## Content Discovery

- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://za.pinterest.com/ideas/): Content discovery hub featuring recipes, home ideas, and trending picks

## Developer Platform & APIs

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com/): Developer platform for Pinterest API, Conversions API, and Shopping API
- [Pinterest Developers](https://dev.pinterest.com/): Developer platform overview with API tools and integration resources

## Optional

- [Home Account (home_account) - Profile](https://ca.pinterest.com/home_account/): User profile page for Home Account showcasing their Pinterest boards
